name: What Inspections Are Required for a Room Addition?

mainEntity.name: What inspections are usually required during a room addition in Los Angeles County?
mainEntity.text: What inspections are usually required during a room addition in Los Angeles County?

acceptedAnswer.text: A room addition usually goes through several inspections as the work progresses. The most common checkpoints include foundation, framing, rough plumbing, rough electrical, rough mechanical, insulation, drywall, and final inspection. The exact sequence depends on whether the addition includes new bathrooms, HVAC changes, or structural upgrades. Inspections are important because they verify that hidden work is done correctly before walls are closed up. If one step is missed or scheduled out of order, the project can slow down quickly. A contractor should coordinate inspection timing and make sure the crew is ready before each visit so the job does not get stuck waiting for a follow-up. Homeowners should also understand that inspection comments may require corrections before the next phase can proceed. Good scheduling and documentation help keep the addition moving without unnecessary downtime.
